root_cause: The canonical Problem Library was expanded from version 1.0.0 to 1.1.0 with PH-P031..PH-P040, but the long-standing baseline contract test still hard-coded version 1.0.0 and a minimum of 30 problems. The protected merge did not require the BRAIN backend lane, so the stale assertion was only surfaced after merge.
prevention_rule: Any canonical problem taxonomy version/count change must co-change tests/brain-powerhouse-problem-library.test.mjs in the same candidate. Post-merge main readback must include this baseline regression before LIVE_BEWEZEN.
fix: Raise baseline minimum canonical problem count from 30 to 40.
Bind the regression to the same Powerhouse Problem Radar obligation.

invariants: baseline problem-library test version equals the canonical library version
baseline problem count floor reflects the canonical expansion
post-merge LIVE_BEWEZEN remains blocked until main regression passes
